title: Tenure Reduction on Expedite Charges - Ostomy Supply Program
content:
A tenure reduction applies to the Ostomy Supply Program charge for a refill shipped expedited at the customer's request, according to how long the program has been active: the whole calendar months from the program's activation date to today.

| Months active | Tenure rate |
|---|---|
| 36 or more | 5% (the long-tenure rate) |
| At least 12 but fewer than 36 | 2% (the mid-tenure rate) |
| Fewer than 12 | None |

The tenure rate is taken off the fee.

**Boundaries (hypothetical).** 11 months: none. 12 months: 2%. 35 months: 2%. 36 months: 5%.
